resources.string: Everyone gets two private cards. Five shared cards are dealt face up in the middle: the flop (three), then the turn (one), then the river (one).

Make the best five-card hand from your two cards and the five on the table. From weakest to strongest: high card, pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight, flush, full house, four of a kind, straight flush.
You bet before the flop and after each new card. On your turn fold, check, call, or bet and raise with the slider and the Min, half-pot, pot and all-in buttons.
The small and big blinds are forced bets that move around the table with the dealer button. They can rise as the game goes on, so a game always ends.
If you go all in for less than the bet, the extra chips form a side pot you cannot win. Chips are for play only: the last player holding chips wins the tournament.
Texas Hold\'em is said to have started in Robstown, Texas, in the early 1900s, and the Texas legislature recognised the town as its birthplace in 2007.
